retrievalLimitations: Current meg_rulebook_en.pdf and asc_rulebook_en.pdf official web links returned iframe shells or could not be opened; do not report latest PDFs as read
Exact end-of-turn expiration versus Pokemon Checkup priority is not newly established by the reviewed excerpts; existing order was not changed
No Asia/Japan ruling has been imported into the international ruleset; no PTCG Live logs were accessed
implementationLimits: Only resumable active Ability, Trainer and AFTER_ATTACK programs gain compound return/shuffle continuation
Automatic departure reactions and direct Knock Out plus departure combinations are rejected before mutation
Absent-object conditions use unavailable truth, not guessed last-known state; this is not complete LKI or replacement-effect support
Tests use synthetic programs, not additional audited real-card bindings
